learningObjectives: Identify interaction patterns that communicate system behavior.
Design appropriate feedback for user actions and system states.
Use microinteractions to improve clarity without adding unnecessary complexity.

activities.title: Interaction State Explorer
activities.instruction: Trigger each interaction state to reveal its purpose.

content.concept: Interaction states communicate what users can do, what they are doing, and what the system is doing.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Feedback Matcher
activities.instruction: Match each user action with suitable feedback.

content.concept: Feedback confirms actions and communicates results through visual, textual, motion, or sensory cues.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Microinteraction Builder
activities.instruction: Build a microinteraction from trigger to response.

content.concept: A microinteraction connects a trigger, system response, feedback, and sometimes a resulting state change.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Feedback Timing Lab
activities.instruction: Adjust feedback timing and observe the experience.

content.concept: Feedback should appear at an appropriate time so users understand whether their action succeeded, failed, or is still processing.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
